summary: Verified the ORA Guide suggestions migration from Ask Advisor sidebar → floating OraGuideMascot bubble. Logged in as test@aurem.dev on preview URL, exercised every founder-listed requirement. All primary acceptance criteria pass: sidebar card gone, mascot suggestion mode wired to /findings/starter-suggestions with real personalized data (FROM YOUR REPO badges), click-to-prefill posts 'aurem:starter-pick' → ChatPanel setInput fills the [data-testid=chat-input] textarea without sending, and Open Advisor / Close links both work.
verified_flows: Ask Advisor sidebar (ds2-advisor-real) opens via ds2-advisor-open; ds2-advisor-guide-slot count = 0 and prompt-starter-panel count = 0 → sidebar ORA GUIDE card fully removed. Header, morning brief, Diagnose/Summarize/Token chips still render.
Floating mascot (ora-guide-mascot-avatar) present; click opens ora-guide-bubble in 'suggestions' mode (ora-guide-suggestions-intro shown, stage/general variants NOT shown).

GET /api/aurem-dev/findings/starter-suggestions?project_id=p_demo_a&limit=4 returned 200 with 4 personalized suggestions; mascot rendered 4 ora-guide-suggestion-* buttons with label + italic example (Hardcoded SECRET_KEY, SQL injection, Hardcoded AWS key, etc.), each carrying FROM YOUR REPO badge (personalized:true).

Clicked first suggestion → bubble closed (visible=False), composer textarea [data-testid=chat-input] contained the exact example prompt string ('Fix this critical issue: Hardcoded SECRET_KEY in source code ...'); no auto-send occurred (composer still shows text, no new user message appended).
Open Advisor button inside the suggestions bubble → dispatched aurem:ora-open, bubble closed, [data-testid=ds2-advisor-real] became visible.
Close button inside the suggestions bubble → bubble removed from DOM.
Onboarding stage bubble path untouched (user is past all stages so no auto-open fired — expected; toggleOpen prefers stage > suggestions > general logic present in code).
notes: 'No-project fallback → general menu' path could not be fully re-exercised in this account because test@aurem.dev owns projects and TabBar's useActiveProject re-selects one on every reload (aurem_active_project + aurem_projects_cache persisted). The code path (effectiveProjectId falsy → panelMode='general' with Open Advisor / Contact support / Close) is unchanged and was verified by inspection in OraGuideMascot.jsx toggleOpen(). Would need a zero-project account to E2E it, but founder note explicitly said this branch is unchanged/pre-existing behavior.
Two 401/403 console errors observed on initial dashboard load — pre-existing (GitHub App revoked banner + unrelated background call), not caused by this change.
critical_code_review_comments: Suggestion slug is used as a React key AND embedded into data-testid; some backend slugs contain spaces, parentheses and colons (e.g. 'finding-ora_chat_audit::snippet (not found in connected repo — p'). Works, but non-CSS-safe data-testid strings could break future selectors. Consider slugifying on the frontend before use.

OraGuideMascot.jsx polls /auth/me/funnel-stage every 15s indefinitely; combined with the new starter-suggestions fetch on every project change it's fine, but if starter-suggestions ever becomes expensive add a short cache.
